description: SokoSense API contract — Ian (UI), Lucy (AT webhook), and Job (engines) build against this.

POST /api/advisory.description: RAG advisory engine — answer farmer questions using Postgres knowledge tables + pgvector + weather + LLM

request.query: string (required) — farmer question, e.g. 'What causes maize rust in Nakuru?'

response.sources: array of strings — knowledge and data sources used

POST /api/market.description: Market decision engine — where to sell

request.location: string (required) — farmer's market or county, e.g. nakuru

response.best_market: string | null — recommended market if different
response.local_price_kes: number | null — price at local market per 90kg bag
response.best_price_kes: number | null — price at best market
response.price_diff_kes: number | null — gain per bag if farmer travels

POST /api/timing.description: Sell timing engine — when to sell

POST /api/loan.description: Loan APR engine — safe or not safe

GET /api/logs.description: Query log for admin dashboard and SACCO feed

items.engine: string — market | timing | loan | sms | advisory

GET /api/market-prices.description: Price table for Ian's Leaflet map

POST /webhook/sms.description: Africa's Talking SMS webhook — Lucy implements handler; contract for Ian simulator
POST /webhook/sms.note: Lucy owns implementation; simulator may POST same shape or call /api/advisory after parse
